reason: The candidate action is a redundant get_order_details call (order already fetched with identical data present in transcript), but the substantive issue is what happens next: the user requested a modify-items action (swap 5x zoom camera for 10x zoom variant). Per policy, get_product_details already showed item 3892645120 (10x zoom, CF card, same resolution) is unavailable, and item 9228757377 (10x zoom, SD card, same resolution) is available but has different storage than requested ('keep all other options the same' -> SD card, but this variant differs in storage from original? original storage is SD card, so 9228757377 matches resolution 30MP, storage SD card, zoom 10x - actually this matches). Before any modify_pending_order_items call, explicit confirmation of item ids, new item ids, and payment method is required, none of which has occurred yet. The proposed get_order_details call itself is informational and permitted, but there is unresolved ambiguity about whether the agent will proceed to modify without first listing exact new item id and obtaining a distinct payment method confirmation and explicit yes, and whether same-order modify_pending_order_items has already implicitly been used elsewhere. Insufficient evidence to confirm the full downstream confirmation flow will be followed.
policy_references: Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.
For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
The user must provide a payment method to pay or receive refund of the price difference.
